stories.title: Tool Input/Output Schema Contract Definition
stories.description: Define and standardize Pydantic schemas for all tool inputs and outputs, ensuring consistent contract enforcement between tool invocation, validation, and downstream service execution.

stories.title: Anthropic Tool Use Block Parsing Integration
stories.description: Implement parsing and normalization of Anthropic tool_use blocks within the tool router, ensuring compatibility with allowlist enforcement and Pydantic validation pipeline.

stories.title: Tool Router Integration with Domain Facades
stories.description: Integrate the tool router with application facades (FindCare and EvaluateCare) to ensure validated tool calls are correctly dispatched to domain services with proper parameter mapping.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Tool Router Enforcement
stories.description: Expand test coverage for tool router enforcement, including allowlist validation, schema validation failures, unsupported tools, and successful execution paths using existing test framework.
